label: Aperture
intent: Open to stopped down: the six blades sweep in together and close the iris to a small opening, like an aperture ring clicking to a smaller f-stop. Light: one decisive close that stops dead on the stop, bounces open a little off it and settles. Strong: the iris stops down in two clicks, half way and then fully, each landing with a bounce, the second harder. The ring never moves. Reverse opens the blades again.

blade-0.//: each blade is v1's open line and v1's stopped-down line; the one 'iris' driver moves all six together, as the linked blades of a real iris do

iris.//: 0 open, 1 stopped down; the bounces only reopen a little off the stop, never past it
